description.value: Shinobi Sushi Express is a takeout-only Japanese restaurant in Maple Ridge serving freshly made sushi, bento boxes, donburi, noodles, and a wide range of specialty rolls. The restaurant recently launched an expanded 'Express Bento' lineup with 20 bento box varieties available all day, alongside party trays and combination sets suited to groups. Delivery is also available via phone or SkipTheDishes for orders over a threshold.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at shinobiexpress.com loaded successfully and confirms the business is open, takeout-only, and operating at 150-11939 240 St, Maple Ridge, BC. The OSM phone number +1-604-969-2811 matches the website's (604) 969-2811. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; takeout is explicitly confirmed by both OSM (takeaway=only) and the website's prominent 'Order Pickup' option.
concerns: OSM record lacks a full street address; addr:unit=150 is present but no street. Full address sourced from website: 150-11939 240 St, Maple Ridge, BC V4R 1M7.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible takeout restaurant confirmed open by a functioning website with current menu and contact details.
